limits: Web tools often expose cached indexed retrievals. These establish public source content as retrieved, not a fresh live audit of institutional websites.
Four grouped-name searches across histecon.fr and sciencespo.fr/histoire returned no results; these do not establish absence. Parent event corpus must determine previous appearances, notably Warde.

USC current profile gives Barca's new role; older CISPAC profile still calls her a Beatriz Galindo fellow and older Coimbra biography lists the former institution. Use USC, record the transition rather than collapsing roles.

Jonsson's departmental page calls Scarcity by a different subtitle and gives French translation dates 2025 and 2026 in different places. Use publisher/JSTOR English title; do not assert French translation date without publisher verification.
Vettese current directory includes some older cohorts and the dated announcement specifies Spring 2026. Continued residence on 15 November is not established; recheck before logistics.

Barca's Workers of the Earth publisher page was indexed with description, contents, date and ISBN but direct requests returned 403. The more defensible shortlist anchor is the accessible CUP description of Forces of Reproduction; assessment is description-based, not full-text analysis.
Chatterjee 2024 AHR DOI could not be retrieved; use the successfully retrieved open CSSH article instead. Her Late Acceleration book is a manuscript under contract, not a published book.
third_option: Oscar Sanchez-Sibony, if energy-finance is central and international/online support exists; Paul Warde if practical proximity and methods outweigh novelty.
